newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: French envoy promises fair screening for Thomson.
newsitem.headline: French envoy promises fair screening for Thomson.

text.p: South Korea's Finance Ministry said on Monday a visiting French envoy promised fair competition for the re-launched privatisation of state-run Thomson SA.

French presidential envoy Jean-Claude Paye met South Korea's Finance Minister Han Seung-soo to explain why Paris scuttled the sale of Thomson Multimedia to South Korea's Daewoo Electronics, a move that sparked anger in Seoul.
"For whoever emerges as a new candidate for the privatisation, fair screening will be made," a statement from the Finance Ministry quoted Paye as saying.
Han said a Daewoo purchase of the consumer electronics unit of Thomson SA would have contributed to better economic relations between France and South Korea.
"If the privatisation had been successful, that would have greatly helped Korea-French economic ties," Han said.
France scrapped the sale of Thomson to Lagardere Groupe late last year after objections by the French privatisation commission to plans to spin off Thomson Multimedia to Daewoo.
